entries.title: Variable 'response' should be initialized on declaration
entries.rationale: The capture is assigned before every supported read. The forwarder response is assigned at each loop iteration; the two Promise captures are assigned inside assert.doesNotThrow to prove native async rejection rather than synchronous throw.
entries.recommendation: Initialize capture to null; preserve assignment inside doesNotThrow and subsequent instanceof Promise/reject assertions. Null is an unread initial sentinel, not a returned value.

entries.recommendation: Initialize capture to null; preserve assignment inside doesNotThrow and subsequent instanceof Promise/reject assertions. Null is an unread initial sentinel, not a returned value.
